newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen at higher end of 126.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen at higher end of 126.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to stay within a recent range at the higher end of 126 on Thursday, but are more likely to break below 126.50 than above 127.00.
Traders said it appeared difficult for the contract to rise to and above 127.00 after Wednesday's late falls.
"I don't see any factors enable us to buy up the June contract to and above 127 yen today," said a dealer at a "Big Four" brokerage house.
"The downside room is seen limited, but an upward challenge is less likely," he added.
The BOJ last announced JGB buying on April 11.
"If there is no BOJ bond buying operation at 10.10 a.m., that would trigger speculation that the BOJ has decided to reduce its JGB buying," a dealer at a Japanese securities house said.
The June could retreat to a recent low of 126.40 if there is no operation, traders said. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-8570
